invariants.text: category.id is an auto-incremented primary key
category.reorder_threshold is optional and defaults to None
product.id is an auto-incremented primary key
product.category_id must reference an existing Category
product.price_cents must be a non-negative integer
product.stock_qty must be a non-negative integer
product.low_active is optional and defaults to False
product.category_id must be valid (exists in Category table)
product.sku must match the format of a valid SKU (if format rules were specified, but none are here)
stock_qty >= 0 when the product is in a state where stock is tracked
reorder_threshold must be a non-negative integer if provided
